title: iSarcasmEval: Intended Sarcasm Detection
description: SemEval-2022 Task 6 (iSarcasmEval): detecting intended sarcasm in English and Arabic. Unlike prior datasets labeled by third parties, iSarcasmEval texts are labeled by their own authors for intended sarcasm. Annotators decide whether a text is sarcastic and, if so, which category of ironic speech it expresses.
